issues.cause: Edge-only attachment escaped B-rep validity and solid-count checks.
issues.correction: Backstop Y7…95mm provides finite face attachment; original wider correction collided with the fork.
issues.verification_or_remaining_work: Thirty poses,28continuous translations,70closed oriented meshes and independent STEP checks. Attachment strength remains open.

issues.cause: Earlier port relief permitted zero-distance contact at some sled stations.
issues.correction: Relieved the cassette port and checked six finite-motion stations per payload.
issues.verification_or_remaining_work: 24pair checks retain no penetration and a minimum4mm gap; full toleranced moving clearance is not established.

issues.cause: Original thin receiver has large displacement; an earlier stiffness result also refers to a different crossbar revision.
issues.correction: Increase stem cross-section and rerun the actual current solid instead of carrying over historical stiffness.
issues.verification_or_remaining_work: 40historical cases plus12actual-FM06 FLR03 analyses, geometry-lineage checks, mesh refinement and force/moment balance. Actual assembled pin/guide contact remains unverified.

issues.cause: Short guides permit excessive bounded rigid rocking; longer tight guides can bind under adverse fit inputs.
issues.correction: Increase guide engagement and evaluate rigid play plus width/alignment/thermal/deflection bands.
issues.verification_or_remaining_work: Rigid excursion reduced, but1117/1215deterministic combinations have nonpositive residual width. Manufacturing process and loaded thermal fit remain open.

issues.cause: Payload load can consume the nominal0.6mm slot gap; actual root and frame are flexible.
issues.correction: Add integral supports and run four native unit-load meshes with explicit scaled sensitivities.
issues.verification_or_remaining_work: Unit compliance converges; adverse load partitions and accelerations do not establish loaded assembly clearance or strength.

issues.cause: Small reported triangle-contact distances coexist with exact-solid overlap; forces and final pose are step/iteration sensitive.
issues.correction: Retain failed native cases and reject dynamic-clearance/contact-force acceptance; refine and correlate the model.
issues.verification_or_remaining_work: FCE08and independent B-rep spot checks demonstrate the numerical limitation. Sequence completion is not acceptance.

issues.cause: Axial captivity, source-rated actuation, independent drive cutoff and installed arrest load path are missing.
issues.correction: Select and integrate actual hardware, define fail-safe mechanics and analyze adverse states.
issues.verification_or_remaining_work: Current source-sized envelopes and force caps are assumptions. No power-loss containment or rated stopping claim.

issues.cause: Reference contacts do not establish approved rail-end loads; forward stop lacks a complete release mechanism.
issues.correction: Define actual spacecraft interface and implement/load-check restraint and release geometry.
issues.verification_or_remaining_work: Native subcycle ends with retained payload; no free separation, empty return or complete reset.

issues.cause: Dedicated1U/3Umodels do not demonstrate one shared installed system.
issues.correction: Integrate an actual shared receiver, indexed cassettes, mounting, harness and source-rated hardware.
issues.verification_or_remaining_work: Mass/CG/inertia are local material proxies, not an installed campaign budget.

issues.cause: Equivalent complete CAD/mass/load/fault evidence is absent for every candidate.
issues.correction: Apply the safety-led mandatory gates before weighted downselect; retain alternatives in Labs.
issues.verification_or_remaining_work: All seven concepts remain unselected. Greater model maturity alone does not justify baseline selection.

boundary: Engineering findings linked to the existing private controlled checklist; these local evidence records do not replace its task statuses.
